balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.desc: Rounds out every style — adapts to whatever you throw.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.desc: Swarm fighter — pushes forward and throws constant combinations.

counter_puncher.label: Counter-Puncher
counter_puncher.desc: Patience personified — slips, then snaps back after your miss.

defensive.label: Defensive
defensive.desc: High guard, tight shell — you must open it up with setups.

pressure_fighter.label: Pressure Fighter
pressure_fighter.desc: Walks you down behind a busy jab — relentless forward pressure.
